reviews.title: Be Careful — Possible Crypto Clipboard Hijacking
reviews.text: I strongly recommend being cautious when using this VPN for anything involving cryptocurrency. After using this app, I experienced what appeared to be a crypto clipboard hijacking attack. I copied a legitimate Bitcoin wallet address, but when I pasted it, the address had been replaced with a different wallet address, resulting in me sending my crypto to the wrong recipient. I can’t definitively confirm the VPN was responsible, but the timing was concerning. I recommend doing your own research and being extremely careful when copying and pasting crypto wallet addresses while using this app.

reviews.title: Concerning! Data transmitted…
reviews.text:
Trust would be a number one priority when using this type of service. Why is that, because when an app such as VPNify states that they never store, sell or engage in facilitating any information to anyone and you rely on that information it becomes concerning when that trust is broken.  

The VPN service connects immediately. It’s fast, however after only a couple days of usage it was discovered that your data and other identifying information is being disclosed to and transmitted to advertisers. Possibly others as well. 

Over 192 organizations were found to have access to your information through this service(each with its own privacy policy) and that’s extremely concerning. 

This app advertises that even on a free account that there’s no logs and no data information transferred.   

Was about to pay for this service but very concerned at this time.

Awaiting response on this situation.
